children: The latest in Solo Stove's 18-month run of innovation delivers up to 30% more heat and up to double the flame brightness, amplifying its Signature Flame's magical swirl, all with quick, simple setup for Solo Stove's 19.5" Bonfire and Summit Fire Pits.
GRAPEVINE, Texas, Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --
, the leading outdoor lifestyle brand within Solo Brands (OTCQB: SBDS) and maker of the world's most popular smokeless fire pits, today announces the

. The sleek, uniquely designed accessory brings a distinct aesthetic to any backyard. For those looking for new ways to gather, just fill a glass, grab a loved one, and unwind in an intimate backyard experience.

The new Chiminea Fire Pit Topper 19.5 is available as an accessory or as part of a matching set with the Bonfire, in Water or Ash color options. It elevates both fire pits with up to 30% more heat right where you want it, plus up to double the flame brightness, boosting the Solo Stove Signature Flame™'s magical swirl. A controlled flame also reduces sparks and contains the fire for added peace of mind. Perfect for cozy gatherings and date nights, it invites all to enjoy a warmer, more connected fireside experience.

"This is our 11th-plus product launch in just the past year, and it speaks to how relentless we are about innovation," said John Larson, President and CEO of Solo Brands. "The Chiminea Fire Pit Topper is another step in that work — we're not just building products, we're continuing to elevate the backyard from a place you visit into a destination you never want to leave."
Key Features include:
Up to 30% More Heat, Right Where You Want It
— Focuses warmth forward instead of up, delivering up to 30% more heat toward you, enough to stretch fire pit season deeper into the colder months.
Up to Double the Flame Brightness
— Amplifies the magical rise and swirl of the Solo Stove Signature Flame™.
A More Controlled Flame
— Helps reduce sparks and contain the fire, making it easier to enjoy in more compact spaces.
Quick, Simple Setup
— Once assembled, it sits securely on top with ease. Place it when you need it, remove it once cooled when you don't.
Built to Last
— Durable all-steel construction with a premium ceramic coating for long-lasting performance and color.
Designed for Solo Stove
— Compatible with 19.5" Solo Stove Fire Pits, including Bonfire and Summit.

"For those new to Solo Stove, the 19.5-inch Fire Pits plus the new Chiminea Topper bring a closer and more intimate fireside experience with our most elevated design yet," said Liz Vanzura, CMO at Solo Stove. "For our current Solo Stove owners, the new Chiminea Topper transforms the whole look and feel of the Smokeless Fire Pit and allows them to enjoy their backyards longer into the season."

The launch responds directly to what Solo Stove's community has been asking for — an accessory that offers more directed warmth and a more controlled flame, letting them stay outside longer on cool nights. For many outdoor hosts, especially those with young kids or pets, that added control also means real peace of mind: less worry about stray sparks, and more time simply enjoying the fire.
